spells.notes: Appointed by 전두환 in the 8·26 개각 while 주유엔대사 (named 1986-08-26, 동아일보 1986-08-26). The other nine new ministers received their 임명장 on 1986-08-27, the date the 외교부 page gives as his start. He was still in New York, 차관 李相玉 stood in for him at the 1986-08-27 국무회의 (한국일보 1986-08-28), and he received his own 임명장 on 1986-09-01 after returning on 08-31. Start follows the batch date on the ministry page, hence medium confidence. ko.wikipedia gives 1986-08-26. The spell ends on 1988-02-25 because the collective resignation of the 제5공화국 cabinet was accepted on the morning of 1988-02-25, and 노태우 then reappointed him the same day (next spell). end_reason 'resigned' records that formal acceptance, as finance.ext88.json (사공일), justice.ext88.json (정해창) and interior.ext88.json (이상희) code the same event. It is not a departure, since the two spells are one continuous stay in office. He held office on 1988-02-25 under this appointment until the acceptance, which puts this spell in the window. The 외교부 page lists 최광수 as a single 21대 entry 1986.08.27 - 1988.12.05, while ko.wikipedia splits the same 대수 into 1986-08-26..1988-02-24 and 1988-02-25..1988-12-05. Birth date from ko.wikipedia only (ko.wikipedia "최광수 (공무원)" https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41920779 (revid 41920779, accessed 2026-09-26T09:49:04-0400, snapshot roster/sources/foreign/ext88/wiki/kowiki_최광수_(공무원).json) lead: '崔侊洙, 1935년 2월 24일' [secondary]). Not a member of the 12th-22nd National Assembly (na_members/na_members_12_22.csv has no 崔侊洙).

spells.notes: Reappointment by 노태우 on inauguration day. 최광수 was one of seven sitting ministers the President-elect announced as 재기용 on 1988-02-19. On 1988-02-25 the 제5공화국 cabinet's collective resignation was accepted in the morning and the PM 서리 and the 23 ministers of the announced list, the seven retained ones included, received 임명장 at 11:40 (경향신문 1988-02-26 p.4). No source names 최광수 individually at the ceremony. The reading that the retained ministers were newly appointed rests on the accepted resignations, the count of 23, and the practice stated by a 총무처 official in 1993 (매일경제 1993-02-24: '만약 유임 되면 임명장만다시 받는다.'). The 법무부 page numbers the retained 정해창 as '36,37대' for the same event (법무부 역대 장관 page https://www.moj.go.kr/minister/2090/subview.do?page=5: "대순 36,37대 성명 정해창 (丁 海 昌) 재임기간 1987.05.26 ~ 1988.12.04" (accessed 2026-09-24T22:37:07-0400, snapshot roster/sources/foreign/ext88/moj_pastministers_p5.html)). Replaced in the 12·5 개각. The 이현재 cabinet submitted a collective resignation on the morning of 1988-12-05 and the new ministers received 임명장 that afternoon. Same-day handover. He said goodbye to the press on the afternoon of 12-05. Birth date from ko.wikipedia only.

spells.notes: Named 외무부장관 in the 12·5 개각 while 주사우디대사. The ministry page and the day's reports date the appointment 1988-12-05, the day the other new ministers received their 임명장. He returned on 1988-12-10 and received his own 임명장 and held his 취임식 on 1988-12-12. Start follows the batch date on the ministry page, hence medium confidence. Retained in the 1990-03-17 개각 (조선일보 1990-03-18, see continuity). Left on 1990-12-27 to become 통일원장관, raised to 부총리 rank (end_reason 'other' = moved to another cabinet post), with the 임명장 given on the afternoon of 12-27. spells.notes: Named in the 12·27 개각 while 주제네바대사. The ministry page and the day's reports give 1990-12-27, the day the new ministers were 임명·발령 and the others received 임명장. His own 임명장 and 취임식 were on 1990-12-31. Start follows the ministry page, hence medium confidence. Retained at the 1991-05 and 1992-10-09 reshuffles (see continuity). Last day set to 1993-02-25. 중앙일보 of 1993-02-25 reports that the outgoing 현승종 cabinet resigned that day and that all resignations were accepted, and the 김영삼 cabinet was appointed on 1993-02-26. This is a single report. The ministry page, ko.wikipedia and Wikidata give 1993-02-26 (the page prints the successor's start as every end date), 매일경제 of 1993-02-24 had reported the 총무처 view that no resignation was needed, and 동아일보 1993-02-26 p.3 reports the outgoing 부총리 최각규 holding his 이임식 on the morning of 02-26. Hence medium confidence (see issues). Birth date not established. Wikidata Q117327463 has the year 1934 only, and there is no ko.wikipedia article. The 13th-Assembly member 이상옥 (李相玉, born 1950-03-22, 평화민주당, na_members_12_22.csv) is a different person, so mp_hint is null. Age 57 in 세계일보 1992-10-10. Verifier note of 2026-09-26. The last day was changed from 1993-02-25 to 1993-02-26. 조선일보 1993-02-24 p.3 reports the government's explanation that the 6共 PM and ministers stay in office until their successors are formally appointed, and the new cabinet was appointed on 1993-02-26 with the 임명장 that afternoon. Outgoing ministers of the same cabinet came to work and held their 이임식 on 1993-02-26 (서울신문, 서울경제, 국민일보 and 한겨레, stories the builder did not cite), and the 외교부 page gives 1993.02.26. The single contrary report is 중앙일보 1993-02-25 ('25일 일괄사표를 제출,전원 수리됐다'), kept in end_sources. The handover to 한승주 is now same-day, as at the other handovers of this file and in the other ext88 lineages for this transition.

issues.desc: Cross-lineage convention for 1988-02-25. The 제5공화국 cabinet's collective resignation was accepted on the morning of 1988-02-25 and the 23 ministers of 노태우's list received 임명장 that day, seven of them retained from the 전두환 cabinet (외무 최광수, 내무 이상희, 재무 사공일, 법무 정해창, 체육 조상호, 건설 최동섭, 체신 오명, 동아일보 and 경향신문 1988-02-19). This file splits 최광수 into a 전두환 spell ending 1988-02-25 (end_reason 'resigned') and a 노태우 spell starting 1988-02-25. The 법무부 page numbers 정해창 '36,37대' and ko.wikipedia splits 최광수's row at 1988-02-24/25, while the 외교부 page shows one entry. State of the sibling files at the resumed run of 2026-09-26. finance.ext88.json (사공일), justice.ext88.json (정해창) and interior.ext88.json (이상희) split the same way with end_reason 'resigned', and this file now uses that code too (the first run had 'other'). sports.ext88.json keeps 조상호 as one spell from 1987-07-14 to 1988-12-05 with no split, and no construction or ict ext88 file existed yet. The orchestrator should make sports, construction (최동섭) and ict (오명) consistent.

Start dates of ministers named while posted abroad follow the batch date printed on the 외교부 page, which is the day the other new ministers were appointed. Each man's own 임명장 came later. 최광수 was named 1986-08-26, the batch date was 08-27 and his own 임명장 09-01. 최호중 was named on the batch date 1988-12-05 and got his own 임명장 on 12-12. 이상옥 was named on the batch date 1990-12-27 and got his own on 12-31. 공로명 was named 1994-12-23, the batch date was 12-24 and his own 임명장 12-26. The legal appointment date cannot be read from a 관보 (gwanbo.go.kr lists 제10424호 1986-08-27, 제10428호 1986-09-01, 제11100호 1988-12-06 and 제11709호 1990-12-27 with file_size 0). These starts are marked medium. 매일경제 1990-12-27 reports the 1990 appointments as '임명·발령' on 12-27, which supports the batch date.

이상옥's last day is 1993-02-25, based on the report in 중앙일보 1993-02-25 that the ministers of the 현승종 cabinet handed in blanket resignations that day and that all were accepted. This is the only source for 1993-02-25, so the date does not meet the two-source rule. The resumed run of 2026-09-26 searched again and found no second report (steps 20 and 21). The search covered the 대한민국사연표 for 1993-02-24 to 02-27, the 대통령기록관 김영삼 1993 schedule, and BigKinds and News Library queries over 1993-02-25 to 03-01 for 일괄사표, 사표, 사표 수리, 이임식, 李相玉 and 외무장관 이임 (snapshots roster/sources/foreign/ext88/hist_1993-02-2[4-7].html, pa_schedule_김영삼_1993_step20_*.html, bk_search_1993c_*.json, bk_search_1993d_*.json, nl_search_1993c_*.json, nl_search_1993d_*.json, step20_1993c.json and step21_1993d.json). The 외교부 page, ko.wikipedia and Wikidata give 1993-02-26, the successor's start. 매일경제 1993-02-24 had reported a 총무처 view that no resignation was needed. Outgoing ministers held their 이임식 on 1993-02-26 (최각규 and 이용만 in 동아일보 1993-02-26 p.3, 한봉수 in 경향신문 1993-02-27 p.6, 진념 in 조선일보 1993-02-27 p.5), and no report of 이상옥's own 이임식 was found. The handover is adjacent either way. The ext88 files disagree. foreign, education (조완규) and general_affairs (이문석) end on 1993-02-25, all on the same 중앙일보 report, and pm.ext88.json ends 현승종 on 1993-02-25 because 황인성 was appointed that afternoon. agriculture, culture, defense, energy, environment, epb, finance, interior, justice, public_info, science, sports and unification end on 1993-02-26. The orchestrator should pick one convention for the ministers. If it is 1993-02-26, this spell's end moves to 1993-02-26 and stays medium. Verifier note of 2026-09-26. Resolved. The last day is now 1993-02-26, see verification.changes. education.ext88.verified.json (조완규) was moved to 1993-02-26 by its verifier and the rebuilt general_affairs.ext88.json (이문석) already ends on 1993-02-26, so all ext88 lineages now end the 현승종 cabinet ministers on 1993-02-26. pm.ext88 ends 현승종 on 1993-02-25, which is a separate office.

공로명's last day is 1996-11-06, the day his resignation was accepted (조선일보, 서울경제, 매일경제 1996-11-07). The 외교부 page prints 1996.11.07, following its same-day convention. The from_main spell of 유종하 starts 1996-11-07 (임명장 day), and the new evidence here agrees with it (named 11-06, 임명장 11-07, 동아일보 1996-11-08). No change is proposed to the main file.

No vacancy in the lineage from 1986-08-27 to 1998-02-27. All handovers are same-day or adjacent. Retention at the reshuffles of 1990-03, 1991-05, 1992-10, 1993-12, 1995-12 and 1997-08 is documented in continuity. For 1994-04 and 1997-03 only presence in office is shown (대통령기록관 schedule 1994-08-01, 1997-08-06) and pre-event reports of retention (국민일보 1997-03-05). No reappointment at these reshuffles was found. In 1990-03 only the new ministers received 임명장 (조선일보 1990-03-18).

Birth dates come from ko.wikipedia and Wikidata only (secondary). 이상옥's birth date is unknown (Wikidata year 1934 only, no ko.wikipedia article). None of the five sat in the 12th-22nd Assembly. The 13th-Assembly member 이상옥 (李相玉, born 1950) is a different person.

News Library texts are OCR. Quotes were matched to the stored OCR text, which keeps the paper's missing spaces and hanja. Names and dates were read in several papers of the same day. Page images were not opened.

Verifier (2026-09-26). Start dates of the four ministers named while abroad (최광수 1986, 최호중 1988, 이상옥 1990, 공로명 1994) stay on the batch date given by the 외교부 page. Two alternatives remain on record, the announcement day (대한민국사연표 dates 최광수's 임명 to 1986-08-26) and each man's own 임명장 day (1986-09-01, 1988-12-12, 1990-12-31, 1994-12-26). 경향신문 and 매일경제 of 1990-12-27 describe the 1990 list as 임명·발령 that day, and the 1986 cohort in the other ext88 lineages starts on 1986-08-27. These starts keep medium confidence.
